io.metadata

Class ExcelCoreProperties

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.metadata.ExcelCoreProperties

  • public class ExcelCoreProperties
extends java.lang.Object
    Reads the core document properties stored within an OOXML workbook or spreadsheet.

    The workbook is opened using Apache POI's OPCPackage API rather than loading the complete workbook into memory. This approach minimises memory usage when only document metadata is required, particularly when processing large workbooks.

    The class provides access to common core properties such as title, subject, creator, description, keywords, creation date, modification date, and revision number. Missing string properties and formatted date values are returned as empty strings, whilst missing date values are returned as null.

    Change log:
    • 22 February 2018 - Initial creation.
    • 6 October 2026 - Refactored date formatting to use DateTimeFormatter and updated documentation to British spelling.
    Since:
    22 February 2018

      • getProperties

        public java.util.Properties getProperties()
        Returns the workbook's core document properties as name/value pairs.

        The returned Properties object contains the available core properties, including category, content status, content type, creation date, creator, description, identifier, keywords, last modifying user, last printed date, modification date, revision, subject, and title. Missing values are represented by empty strings in the returned Properties object.

        Returns:
        a new Properties object containing the workbook's core document properties
